verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core interaction model is natural language. Tasks take a natural-language prompt plus a URL, the Playwright layer exposes NL act/extract/validate commands, Copilot chat builds agents from a plain-English description, and SOP upload turns English process descriptions into workflows. Community hands-on reports confirm prompt-driven runs work on the happy path. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that NL commands work reliably beyond the happy path, given a hands-on report of struggling with popups and tabs on an unfamiliar site.
